name: curriculum
description: Curriculum learning system. Skill tree with 5 tracks, difficulty levels (1-9), prerequisites, and mastery tracking. Shows learning paths and unlock status.

commands.path: Show optimal learning path to reach a skill (prerequisites + target). Usage: path <skill_name>
commands.unlock: Check if prerequisites are met for a skill. Usage: unlock <skill_name>
commands.progress: Show mastery level per skill across all tracks
commands.status: Overall curriculum stats: mastery, unlocked, locked, difficulty range
commands.tree: Visual skill tree with mastery levels and lock indicators
